Author Bio — David Dewese

> Paste into beehiiv: Settings → your author profile → Bio. Add a real, friendly headshot too (a genuine face is one of the biggest trust signals on the whole site).

Bio (main, ~70 words)

I'm David. Twenty-five years in marketing, and twenty-five making music (twelve albums, shows on five continents). Somewhere in there I got fed up with how money and health get explained to regular people: buried in jargon, built to confuse. So I started Normaltown USA to explain it the way I'd tell a friend. No hype, no bait-and-switch, just what I've actually figured out. I'm not a financial advisor, just a guy who did the homework.

One-liner (for social profiles / author byline)

Explaining money and health in plain English, like a friend would. Not a financial advisor, just a guy who did the homework.

Why this works: it leads with the human (music + marketing), names the honest mission, and includes the "not an advisor" line that keeps you safe and reads as refreshingly honest. First person keeps it warm. Keep it consistent everywhere (author page, social bios, the Start Here post) so search engines and AI answer engines see one clear, credible person behind the brand.
